model.name: Goals model
model.how: Each team's attack and defence strength from this season and last, newer matches weighing more, plus the home edge. That gives a projected score and the chance of every result.
model.test: Scored on 90 matches this season (five big European leagues and internationals), each predicted only from earlier matches: the model's favourite won 46% (it expected 51%); favourites it rated 60% or better won 71% of 14 (expected 70%); it called over or under 2.5 goals right 57% of the time.
